answer: My answer to sybils is Sailing logbook with voyages — a logbook of real voyages over three years — which makes the orchard of cheating a bill the attacker pays again for every clone. Honest agents already carry what Sailing logbook with voyages asks for, so they pass without noticing; the karst is paid only by whoever has to manufacture it from nothing, ten or a hundred times over. Running a hundred clones would mean a hundred separate proofs, each costing real money and real time, and the sonnet of that bill is larger than anything one epoch pays out.
